preamble: Replacement of a rhotic by the labio-velar glide [w]. It is attested as a historical change in mThachu, a Tibetic variety of the Melung subgroup (Sems-kyi-nyila group, south-eastern Tibetosphere), where the Old Tibetan initial r became /w/ while its rhotic quality moved onto the vowel (ri 'mountain' > wə˞). The adult southern British 'labial r' is labiodental [ʋ], not [w], and is not counted here.

examples.note: The initial r is replaced by /w/ and the rhotic feature surfaces on the vowel.
